region.title: The Coastal Fog
region.description: Weather rolling in off a grey harbour town — where every word begins.

expeditions.clue: When water forgets it has a shape, it rises like this — the first step before something greater forms overhead.
Countless rising things gather high overhead until there's enough of them to see from the ground.
When the air can no longer hold what it's carrying, this is what gathers overhead before the fall.
Water that fell from above and has nowhere left to go but sit.
A thin veil of water clinging low to the ground on a cold morning.
That same low veil, thickened until the whole road disappears into white.
Wind caught in cloth, pushing something small across open water.
Where a boat finally comes to rest against solid ground.
After the sky has wept and the sun returns, a bridge of colour appears where the two meet.
